scope: Claim-level scientific adequacy of this executed candidate only; alternative sound methods use the open-submission route and independent review. The numerical checker itself leaves scientific_pass null.

evidence: All native population weights independently reconstructed
15792 complete observed edge responses and 31,146 simplification/resolution error rows verified
Q1.answer: At 1 eV, equal-weighting q95 shape error 0.06541 and first-site q95 error 0.28053; zero equal-weight median does not imply universality. Resolution changes representative-site top 50 membership.
limitations: Coverage table includes 16,178 observed edge groups; 142 wholly absent edge slots are additional unobserved data, not reconstructed responses.
Lowest-index representative and operational symmetry tolerance are methodological choices.
Finite-resolution probe does not establish experimental detectability.

evidence: Direct periodic-image enumeration verifies angular and radial geometry
14 adjusted point contrasts and material-bootstrap intervals independently reproduced using weighted residualized least squares
Q2.answer: Element/ligand-adjusted nominal contrast -0.01201 has interval [-0.01530,-0.00868]. Exact-composition contrast -0.01467 has interval [-0.04305,0.00201] on only 301 sites / 108 materials; a composition-invariant effect is not established.
limitations: Operational raw-area ratios are not experimental white-line or spin-sum-rule quantities.
One strict-shell exact-composition interval barely excludes zero, so neither universal effect nor unconditional null is warranted.
Residual chemical confounding and regular-geometry selection remain.

evidence: 5408 source-derived geometry labels on 3,602 materials / 3,339 reduced compositions independently checked
Training-only baselines, metrics, confusion matrices and paired composition-bootstrap intervals reconstructed

Q3.answer: Unbroadened L2 increment in balanced accuracy 0.00217 has interval [-0.00076,0.00574]; 1 eV increment 0.00143 likewise unresolved. This does not prove absence of L2 information.
limitations: One fixed learner and operational regular-geometry labels.
Composition bootstrap conditions on fitted folds rather than refitting models.
Per-element minority support is uneven; experimental transfer is untested.
